text: I don't give trade instructions or sizing; the decision stays with you, and any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. What the pack does show: since 2001 WTI's release-day return has averaged -0.3481% per 1 sd crude-stock surprise (-0.223% since 2015), a contemporaneous relation that forecasts nothing about the surprise itself. The next WPSR is on 2026-10-28.
